items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER asks about Frank Black or Nat Schilkret; INTERVIEWEE responds only discussing Nat Schilkret ('I worked for him more than anyone else').

ctx.x: Now who were the more or less useful directors there, Frank Black or Nat Schilkret or anybody like that?

Nat Schilkret was one of them. And although he didn't know jazz at all. He'd have to take our word for what's good jazz. So Nat Schilkret, I think was the - I worked for him more than anyone else. He liked me, on account of my easy going way, my pace. He liked my pace. So that was it.
